candidate.display_name: GHOST Energy x A&W Root Beer
candidate.exact_object_rule: Retain an original post only when GHOST is tied to A&W or Root Beer by an adjacent product phrase, or a known GHOST Energy/Lifestyle identity is paired with A&W or Root Beer. Reject distant namesake collisions such as ghost hunting plus an unrelated A&W mention. Comments and replies inherit only from a retained exact original post.

status_rules.complete_relevant: The authenticated query completed and returned at least one exact product post.
status_rules.complete_no_match: The authenticated query returned posts, but all failed the exact product rule.
status_rules.empty: The authenticated source exposed an explicit no-results state with zero parsed posts.
status_rules.failed: Authentication, network, parser, timeout, budget or ambiguous-zero result; never convert this to zero conversation.
status_rules.bounded_partial: A thread read returned records without a connector error but the source reported more records or the cap was reached.

old_method_defect: The prior GHOST monitor delegated to the generic candidate collector. For this canonical query that produced only one X phrase, one TikTok phrase, and a small Instagram fallback basket.
The prior widened run used collect-only mode with comment hydration disabled, so it read zero comments or replies even when a retained post could have had a thread.
Ranked bounded search and a single phrase cannot establish platform-wide absence. The corrected result reports only what the frozen authenticated queries observed within their caps.
recovery_procedure: Preserve and hash the failed artifact; never edit it in place.
Rerun only the failed platform after its same-shape known-positive search and depth canary passes.
Run every frozen source-native product query even after one query finds a post, then deduplicate by platform and native post ID.
Apply the exact product rule before reading threads.
Read comments and replies for every retained exact post within the frozen cap and depth, recording returned count, source-reported total, truncation, route and error.
Merge retry evidence by platform and native post ID, recompute counts offline, and retain every earlier attempt in audit history.
A new wider query basket starts a new baseline and must not be described as momentum versus the old smaller basket.
